evidence.fact: Shopify is exactly authMode none, transport http, fixed official catalog resource.
Keyless exception matches exact fixed Shopify registry resource; method/target and tools-call permit checks remain.
Status is emitted immediately after response headers, before stream parsing or MCP handshake acknowledgement.
POST supplies Accept text/event-stream, application/json, Content-Type application/json and propagates custom headers/session header; worker does not remove them.
HTTP 200 still requires supported Content-Type and valid complete ServerJsonRpcMessage or parsed SSE. Missing/wrong Content-Type, JSON decode failure or stream failure still fails.
Initialized-notification accepts Accepted or valid JSON; an SSE response is rejected even with HTTP 200.
Negotiated MCP-Protocol-Version is inserted in notification and later request headers. Session ID is propagated when supplied; default allows stateless operation.
InitializeRequestParams::new sends the SDK default protocol 2025-11-25. No source evidence alone establishes provider incompatibility.
Initialize has up to three attempts with 250 ms and 1000 ms backoff; notification TransportChannelClosed is retryable.
The caller erases all initialize typed errors to Failure::Unavailable after normal client shutdown.
UCP profile constraint is part of reviewed tool arguments after tools discovery, not an initialization header. No evidence justifies inventing an initialize profile header.
